sources.rationale: Prepare current policy before work and revalidate at the guarded seal boundary; no donor framework/runtime.
Short caller transaction, tenant-bound immutable identity checks and explicit rollback; retain existing KnowKit lease/fence/CAS/outbox owners.
Crash/rollback/immutable-identity negative scenarios adapted to restricted PostgreSQL runtime role and real process termination.
Persist staged candidate inventory and source receipts for reconciliation; distinguish interrupted/unknown from accepted. Reject file-journal as another owner.
Complete inventory/counts and explicit unavailable semantics; reject truncated presentation manifest as publication authority.
New staging generation preserves historical identity. Replace short signatures, nonempty-directory readiness and latest/legacy fallback with full domain digest, exact refs and persisted reads.
Retain previous active snapshot on incomplete generation; test persisted reload/read failures and assets without a paid embedding call.

reuseScope: Algorithmic adaptation and regression scenarios only. No donor runtime dependency, framework coupling, source text copying, file-journal owner or upstream test pass claimed.

licenses.agentools: Private reuse authority from the execution-input; no donor implementation copied.
licenses.deeptutor: Apache-2.0; retained license/notices in docs/architecture/third-party/DeepTutor-LICENSE.txt and DeepTutor-THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

newCodeRationale: Approved exact IndexManifest/chunkset identity schema, tenant-qualified existing catalog boundaries, PostgreSQL FTS, durable lease/fence and transactional outbox differ from donor persistence. New vendor-free PHP adapters/application checks preserve those contracts.
sourceGaps: No permitted plan read API is exposed in this runtime; supplementary reuse-policy/context references were not loaded. All four required reads were supplied inline and read.
Optional external vector/graph adapters are not implemented; fingerprint semantics use an explicitly named contract double.
Plan evidence mirror is not written because result_contract.plan_mutation is forbidden. The tracked receipt is authoritative for this executor handoff.

validation.donorHashes: Seven shortlisted source SHA256 values matched the pinned execution-input.
